The Teapot Heist is a made-up film about a made-up crew who plan to steal a teapot from a made-up museum.

Directed by Nobody Real. Written by Nobody Else.

Prudence Fennimore

  • [to the kettle] You have been whistling since Tuesday, and I have decided to take it personally.
  • A heist is just a picnic with worse sandwiches.
    • Ranked #1 in the Imaginary Institute's list of the top 100 fictional lines.

Barnaby Quillfeather

  • @everyone, the teapot is on the move, and it has no idea how important it is.
  • I have rehearsed this speech in the shower, in the car and once, regrettably, in front of a goat. The plan is simple: we walk in, we look like we belong, and we walk out with the teapot while the guard is distracted by the most interesting sandwich ever made. If anyone asks, we are a delegation from the Society for the Preservation of Slightly Chipped Crockery, and we are here to inspect the spout. If anyone asks a second question, we run. Nobody asks a third question, because by then we are in the getaway wheelbarrow.

Dialogue

Prudence: Did you bring the map?
Barnaby: I brought a map. It is a map of somewhere else, but it is a very good map.
Prudence: [sighing] Of course it is.
Guard: Halt. Who goes there?
Barnaby: Nobody. We are nobody.
...
Guard: Carry on, then.
Prudence: Tell me the plan one more time.
Barnaby: We walk in, we look like we belong, and we walk out.
  • Bolded section ranked #2 in the Imaginary Institute's list of the top 100 fictional plans.

Misattributed

  • MISATTRIBUTED LINE: Everybody loves a teapot.
    • This line never appears in the film.
